# Keep keyboard focus accessible when users discard an unsaved draft

## What & Why
The recovery notice now returns focus to a visible page action when a draft expires. The parallel manual-discard path should provide the same keyboard-safe behavior instead of leaving focus on a removed Discard button.

## Done looks like
- Discarding an answer draft moves focus to the visible New answer control.
- Discarding an opportunity draft moves focus to the visible Add opportunity control.
- The discard announcement remains available and no form opens.
